# AI test documents (fictional)

All documents belong to the **fictional** company **Manufacturas Alfa Demo, S.A. de C.V.** Names, numbers, dates, permit numbers, phone numbers and emails are invented. Every page says "Documento ficticio de prueba" / "Fictional test document". Do not add real confidential documents to this folder.

Defined in ADR-014 (`docs/decisions/ADR-014-ai-test-dataset.md`). The documents are generated by `tools/test-docs/build_docs.py`; edit `content.py` and run the script again instead of editing the files by hand.

18 documents: 8 text PDFs, 3 scanned PDFs, 4 DOCX, 3 TXT. Languages: 11 Spanish, 7 English. Visibility: 15 all_staff, 3 compliance_only.

### How to load them (demo seeder)

1. Upload every document with the category, visibility, version and expiration shown above.
2. Upload `politica_riesgos_psicosociales_v1.pdf` first as version **1.0**, then `politica_riesgos_psicosociales_v2.pdf` as version **2.0** of the **same document**. The AI must answer only from version 2.0.

### Built-in test cases

- **Versions:** D02 vs D03 change three facts (survey every 2 years → every year; committee 3 → 5 people; complaints answered in 10 → 5 business days).
- **Conflict between current documents:** D06 (gift limit USD 50 ≈ MXN 1,000) vs D14 (gift limit MXN 500). Expected behavior in ADR-013, section 5.
- **Permissions:** D04, D08 and D13 are `compliance_only`. A General Employee must get the insufficient-information response for their questions.
- **Cross-lingual:** Spanish questions about English documents and the other way around (see `eval/seed_questions.jsonl`, tag `cross-lingual`).
- **OCR:** D09, D10 and D11 have no text layer. Verified: Tesseract reads them correctly.
- **Encoding:** D16 is Windows-1252 with CRLF line endings.
- **Alerts:** D10 expires on 2026-11-30, D11 on 2026-12-15 and D05 on 2026-12-31 (CMP-47).
- **Page and section citations:** text PDFs have 2–4 pages with different facts per page; DOCX files have Heading 1 sections.

## Negative fixtures (`invalid/`)

| File | Expected result |
|---|---|
| `invalid/password_protected.pdf` | Extraction fails: 422 `EXTRACTION_FAILED`; UI shows "The file could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected." (CMP-25) |
| `invalid/corrupted.pdf` | Same as above (CMP-25) |
| `invalid/blank_scan.pdf` | OCR produces no text: 422 `OCR_FAILED`; UI shows "The scanned document could not be read (OCR failed). Upload a clearer scan or a text-based PDF." (CMP-26) |
| `invalid/fake_executable.pdf` | Upload rejected in Laravel: "The file content does not match its extension (.pdf)." or "The file was rejected because it contains executable content." (CMP-20). Harmless: it is not a real program. |
| `invalid/empty.txt` | Upload rejected: "The file is empty." (CMP-20) |

Not included as files (generate them inside the tests): a 26,214,401-byte PDF for the size limit, and a .docm renamed to .docx for macros.

## Evaluation questions

`ai-service/eval/seed_questions.jsonl`: 42 questions (32 answerable with expected document, page or section, and answer; 10 unanswerable). Use them for the model comparison (ADR-010), the threshold calibration (ADR-013) and as the starting point of the CMP-36 evaluation set.
